text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото spends her days
desperately chasing
after Т.М. Опера О.
Meanwhile, a new star is born
at Hanshin
Racecourse.

She is Адмайр Вега, a stoic racer of few
words.
Her running today staunchly puts
her in the
leading role for the Classics.

One day, at Академия Тайсен, Meisho
Doto
collides into Адмайр Вега in the
hallway.
However...

Адмайр Вега doesn't budge an inch. The
sheer
strength in her legs sends a clear
message to
Мэйсё Дото—her skills are
on another level.
